description: Defines an abstract class 'ConfigFragment' with virtual methods for serialization and deserialization, used for configuration management in the 'cuttlefish' project.

classes.name: ConfigFragment
classes.description: An abstract base class providing an interface for configuration fragments, including methods for obtaining the fragment's name and for serializing/deserializing data.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the configuration fragment.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the configuration fragment into a JSON value.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Populates the configuration fragment from a JSON value.
